A1.script: harness/probe_delivery.py, unchanged plan: 7 blocks per binary (blocks 1-6: 20 T, 20 D, 20 Y in rotating patterns; block 7: 5 N_bg, 5 N_domfg). One fresh Driver + browser per block.
A1.interleaving: block b runs as one SHARED hold of one AB pair: odd b = M9 then MF9, even b = MF9 then M9
A1.forced_path: T: browser_type token, then browser_click {ref: Submit, delivery_mode: foreground} on the default trusted route (CDP Input.dispatchMouseEvent): the branch that activates the browser window on Linux
A1.producer_attribution: public receipt route=trusted_input (only BrowserClickTool's trusted branch emits it); the executed-branch stamp (producer delivery_mode from trusted_delivery_mode) is read directly in UNIT, since the dispatch seam replaces the legacy payload
A1.oracle: fixture page's own capture-phase event log via sendBeacon: pointerdown and click on Submit with isTrusted, document.hasFocus() and visibilityState at event time; fixture /state == token and POST journal. X11 active window pre/post reported, not gated.

definitions.page_trusted_foreground: first pointerdown on Submit isTrusted && hasFocus && visibility==visible, and first click on Submit isTrusted
definitions.T_correct: click accepted && receipt delivery.mode == foreground && page_trusted_foreground
definitions.T_mislabel: click accepted && receipt delivery.mode == background && page_trusted_foreground

A-decoy.script: harness/probe_activation.py --blocks 2 (6 trials per block, alternating T/D), 2 invocations per binary = 12 D + 12 T per binary (the harness granularity gives 12 >= the requested 10)
A-decoy.interleaving: pair 1 = M9 then MF9, pair 2 = MF9 then M9; each pair one SHARED hold
A-decoy.background_case: D = browser_click {ref: Submit, input_route: dom_event} with a Tk decoy window made active before the click
A-decoy.D_correct: click accepted && receipt delivery.mode == background && page click on Submit isTrusted == false && X11 active window after the click (focus_post) == decoy && /state == token
A-decoy.T_in_decoy: reported descriptively (expected: browser activated; M9 background, MF9 foreground)

real.A-shape: for every arm (T, D, Y, N_bg, N_domfg, decoy T, decoy D) and for browser_type receipts: the distribution of effect, route, delivery_mode, delivered_count, evidence, escalation, error, summary_template (harness/analyze_a.py receipt()) and the receipt key sets must be identical between M9 and MF9, except T/decoy-T click delivery_mode

B1.binary: M9i (counters on via CUA_DRIVER_EXP_CDP_COUNTER_FILE, set by the probe per Driver process)
B1.script: probe_sessions_observed.py --series L --long-calls 300: one Driver + browser, 300 calls on the jev-use page plus a No-op button (even k: get_browser_state semantic_v2; odd k: browser_click No-op dom_event), navigation probes before k=0,100,200 and after k=299, then one trailing semantic snapshot (added for B2 at 301; not a measured call)
B1.sessions: 3 independent long sessions on M9i (3 SHARED holds), plus 1 long session on plain M9 (observer only; descriptive, not gated). Order: M9i, M9i, M9, M9i.
B1.checkpoints: calls 1, 101, 201, 301 = observer sample immediately before the navigation probe at k = 0, 100, 200, 300
B1.independent_observer: second CDP client on its own browser-level WebSocket (cdp_observer.py), never attached to the page: Chrome's own DevTools.CDPCommandFrom{RemoteDebugger,DevTools} histograms (Browser.getHistograms); live_indep = Target.attachToTarget commands Chrome received - Target.detachFromTarget commands Chrome received (both histograms); plus Target.getTargets attached flag. Calibration gate per sample: Browser.getHistograms bucket count == observer samples so far (the Driver never sends it).
B1.crosscheck: counters live_sessions of the last counter line before the sample; required |live_indep - counters| <= 1 at every checkpoint, else B = RECERT_FAIL (gate oracle_crosscheck)
B1.B2: post-navigation burst = counters events_delta of the first call after the navigation probe at k = 0, 100, 200 (the next measured call) and 300 (the trailing snapshot), reported with live sessions before that call

A.RECERT_PASS: M9 T_mislabel >= 18/20 AND MF9 T_correct == 20/20 AND decoy D_correct 12/12 on M9 and 12/12 on MF9 AND A-shape shows no other change
A.RECERT_FAIL: anything else; the failing gate is named
A.denominators: all 20 T trials per binary, harness errors included as failures

B.RECERT_PASS: live_indep >= 290 at call 301 in each of the 3 M9i sessions (still accumulating), with the crosscheck holding
B.FIXED_UPSTREAM: live_indep <= 5 at call 301 in each of the 3 M9i sessions
